body_markdown:
Convenient Public Storage options in Denver include 2100 Blake Street near Coors Field, 5080 Leetsdale Dr near Glendale, 2170 S Federal Blvd in southwest Denver and 4101 E Evans Ave in southeast Denver. These facilities connect with major routes such as I-25, I-70, U.S. 6 and Colorado Boulevard.


The most convenient location depends on the side of Denver you use most often and the route you take across the city. Compare access hours, unit sizes and storage features before reserving.


## What Public Storage Options Are Available in Denver?


Public Storage has 80 facilities in Denver and nearby communities. Climate-controlled storage is available at 46 facilities, while 60 offer car storage. Available spaces range from lockers to 10×30 units.


Common unit sizes are available throughout the area:


Unit size Denver-area facilities offering the size


5×5 60

Monthly prices start at $10, and the average monthly unit price is $96. Prices, promotions, features and availability vary by location and can change.


## Convenient Self-Storage in Denver: 2100 Blake Street


Public Storage at[2100 Blake Street](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/1019.html) is in Denver’s Ballpark neighborhood near Coors Field, LoDo and downtown, with access from Park Avenue West, I-25 and I-70.


The facility offers climate-controlled storage, car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** The Blake Street location provides a central option for customers who live or work downtown, in Five Points or in nearby neighborhoods. Its connections to I-25 and I-70 can also make it useful for trips from other parts of the city.


## Where Else Can You Find Convenient Self-Storage in Denver?


Denver’s highway network and east-west travel patterns can make the right corridor an important part of choosing a facility.


### Leetsdale Drive Near Glendale


Public Storage at[5080 Leetsdale Dr](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/879.html) is along Leetsdale Drive near Glendale and Cherry Creek, with connections to Colorado Boulevard and East Alameda Avenue.


The facility offers car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Standard access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily, and 24/7 Access is available for eligible customers.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may suit customers in Glendale, Cherry Creek and nearby east Denver neighborhoods who regularly travel along Leetsdale Drive or Colorado Boulevard.


### South Federal Boulevard


Public Storage at[2170 S Federal Blvd](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/788.html) provides a southwest Denver option along Federal Boulevard, with connections to U.S. 285 and U.S. 6.


The facility offers climate-controlled storage, car storage and small, medium and large units, with indoor and outdoor options. Property access is currently available from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.


**Why it’s convenient:** The South Federal Boulevard location can be practical for customers in southwest Denver or those who regularly use Federal Boulevard to travel north and south.


### East Evans Avenue Near I-25


Public Storage at[4101 E Evans Ave](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/877.html) is in southeast Denver near Colorado Boulevard, the University of Denver area and I-25.


**Why it’s convenient:** This location may fit customers in University Hills, Virginia Village and nearby southeast Denver neighborhoods or those whose routine includes I-25 and Colorado Boulevard.


## What Makes a Self-Storage Facility Convenient in Denver?


In Denver, a facility near your side of I-25 or along a familiar east-west road can reduce the time spent crossing the city.


When comparing Denver storage facilities, consider:


- **Your usual route:** Look near I-25, I-70, U.S. 6, U.S. 285 or another road you already use.
- **Part of town:** Compare downtown, east, southwest and southeast options based on where your trips usually begin.
- **Access hours:** All four featured locations currently list standard access from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily.
- [Climate-controlled storage in Denver](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/climate-controlled-storage-units) **:** Denver’s seasonal temperature changes and dry conditions can affect belongings that react to changing environments. These units are designed to help maintain more consistent temperature and humidity levels than non-climate-controlled storage.
- **Indoor or outdoor access:** Indoor units may involve hallway or elevator access. Some outdoor units offer Drive-Up Access, but confirm the feature for the exact unit.
- [Vehicle storage in Denver](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver/car-storage-units) **:** Car, boat, RV and motorcycle storage is available at select Denver-area facilities.
- **Unit size:** Choose enough room for your belongings and a clear path if you expect to retrieve items regularly.


## Which Storage Unit Size Should You Choose?


The right size depends on what you plan to store and how you want to use the space.


- A **5×5 unit** can hold boxes, seasonal decorations and smaller household items.
- A **5×10 unit** can accommodate the contents of one room, including some furniture.
- A **10×10 unit** offers space for furnishings and boxes from several rooms.
- A **10×20 unit** can support a larger move or home project involving multiple rooms.


Actual dimensions and capacities vary. Use the[Public Storage Size Guide](https://www.publicstorage.com/size-guide) and review the specific unit before renting when possible.


## How Do You Choose the Most Convenient Storage Facility in Denver?


Start with the area and route already in your routine. Blake Street may be practical for downtown and LoDo, while Leetsdale Drive provides an east Denver option near Glendale. South Federal Boulevard may suit southwest Denver, and East Evans Avenue can fit customers near I-25 and Colorado Boulevard.


Then compare access hours, unit type, size and features. If you need climate-controlled storage, Drive-Up Access, vehicle storage or 24/7 Access, confirm availability for the exact facility and unit before reserving.


## Frequently Asked Questions About Self-Storage in Denver


### How many Public Storage facilities are in the Denver area?


Public Storage has 80 facilities in Denver and nearby communities. Facility counts and availability can change.


### Where can I find Public Storage near downtown Denver?


The featured facility at 2100 Blake Street is in the Ballpark neighborhood near Coors Field, LoDo and downtown Denver.


### Can I find climate-controlled storage in Denver?


Yes. Climate-controlled storage is available at 46 Denver-area facilities, including the featured Blake Street, South Federal Boulevard and East Evans Avenue locations.


### Is car storage available in Denver?


Yes. Car storage is available at 60 area facilities, including all four featured properties. Space type, dimensions and availability vary.


### Does Public Storage offer 24/7 Access in Denver?


Select locations offer 24/7 Access. The featured Blake Street and Leetsdale Drive facilities currently list this option for eligible customers. Availability and requirements vary.


### What are the access hours at the featured Denver facilities?


All four currently list standard property access from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. daily. Hours can change, so check the individual property page before visiting.


### How much does a storage unit cost in Denver?


Monthly prices start at $10, and the average monthly unit price is $96. Your price will depend on the location, size, features, promotion and current availability.


### How can I find a Public Storage facility near me in Denver?


Search by your address, neighborhood or ZIP code on the[Denver Public Storage page](https://www.publicstorage.com/self-storage-co-denver) . Compare the route, access hours and available unit features for each location.


## Find Convenient Self-Storage in Denver


Public Storage offers options near downtown, Glendale, southwest Denver, southeast Denver and throughout the surrounding area. Choose a facility that fits your regular route, then confirm the unit size, access hours and features before reserving.
